title.en: Scarlett Johansson challenges OpenAI over voice that sounds 'eerily similar' to hers
title.zhHans: 斯嘉丽·约翰逊就 ChatGPT 声音与其"惊人相似"挑战 OpenAI

searchSummary.en: Scarlett Johansson challenged OpenAI in May 2024 over a ChatGPT voice that sounded ‘eerily similar’ to hers. The controversy over AI voice cloning and celebrity likeness rights.
searchSummary.zhHans: 斯嘉丽·约翰逊 2024 年 5 月就 ChatGPT 一个与她「惊人相似」的声音挑战 OpenAI。AI 语音克隆与名人肖像权的争议。

summary.en: On May 20, 2024, actress Scarlett Johansson publicly challenged OpenAI over a ChatGPT voice called 'Sky' that sounded 'eerily similar' to her own. Johansson revealed that OpenAI had approached her nine months earlier to license her voice, she declined, and the company used a voice she believed imitated hers anyway. OpenAI denied deliberate imitation but suspended the voice. The incident became a landmark moment in the debate over AI consent, celebrity likeness rights, and the ethical boundaries of AI voice synthesis.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 5 月 20 日，演员斯嘉丽·约翰逊公开质疑 OpenAI 的一个名为"Sky"的 ChatGPT 声音与其声音"惊人相似"。约翰逊透露，OpenAI 在九个月前曾联系她授权使用她的声音，她拒绝了，而公司仍然使用了她认为模仿了她的声音。OpenAI 否认故意模仿，但暂停了该声音。该事件成为关于 AI 同意权、名人肖像权和 AI 语音合成伦理边界讨论的一个里程碑时刻。

narrative.en: The controversy erupted immediately after OpenAI's GPT-4o demo on May 13, where the 'Sky' voice demonstrated flirtatious, emotionally expressive conversation — drawing instant comparisons to the 2013 film 'Her', in which Scarlett Johansson voiced an AI assistant. When journalists and the public pointed out the similarity, Johansson released a statement saying she was 'shocked, angered and in disbelief' that OpenAI used a voice so similar to hers after she had declined their offer. The timing was particularly charged: the film Her is about a man falling in love with an AI assistant voiced by Johansson, and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman had tweeted a single word — 'her' — on the day of the GPT-4o demo. OpenAI denied the imitation, stating that Sky's voice belonged to a different professional actress using her natural speaking voice. However, the company suspended Sky's use. The incident had lasting effects: it intensified the debate around AI voice consent, influenced California's consideration of AI likeness protection laws (later part of SB 53), and became a cautionary tale cited in virtually every subsequent AI voice ethics discussion. It also highlighted the power imbalance between individual creators and AI companies.
narrative.zhHans: 这场争议在 OpenAI 的 GPT-4o 演示后立即爆发，其中"Sky"声音展示了调情式的、富有情感表达的对话——立即让人联想到 2013 年的电影《Her》（她），片中斯嘉丽·约翰逊为一个 AI 助手配音。当记者和公众指出相似性时，约翰逊发表声明称她"感到震惊、愤怒和难以置信"，OpenAI 在她拒绝合作后使用了与她如此相似的声音。时机特别敏感：电影《Her》讲述的是一个男人爱上由约翰逊配音的 AI 助手的故事，而 OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 在 GPT-4o 演示当天发了一条只有一个词的推文——'her'。OpenAI 否认模仿，称 Sky 的声音属于另一位使用自然说话声音的专业女演员。但公司暂停了 Sky 的使用。该事件产生了持久影响：加剧了关于 AI 语音同意的辩论，影响了加州对 AI 肖像保护法的考虑（后来成为 SB 53 的一部分），并成为几乎所有后续 AI 语音伦理讨论中引用的警示故事。它也凸显了个人创作者与 AI 公司之间的权力不平衡。

description.en: Demonstrated the power imbalance between AI companies and individuals whose voices/likenesses could be replicated without consent. Raised fundamental questions about AI voice consent, celebrity likeness rights, and the adequacy of existing legal protections.
description.zhHans: 展示了 AI 公司与个人之间的权力不平衡——个人的声音/肖像可能在未经同意的情况下被复制。引发了关于 AI 语音同意、名人肖像权以及现有法律保护是否充足的根本性问题。

text.en: Scarlett Johansson publicly challenged OpenAI on May 20, 2024, stating that ChatGPT's 'Sky' voice sounded 'eerily similar' to hers after she had declined OpenAI's licensing offer. OpenAI suspended the voice.
text.zhHans: 斯嘉丽·约翰逊于 2024 年 5 月 20 日公开质疑 OpenAI，表示 ChatGPT 的"Sky"声音与她"惊人相似"，而此前她已拒绝 OpenAI 的授权请求。OpenAI 暂停了该声音。

sources.quote: Johansson said OpenAI used a voice that sounded 'eerily similar to mine.'
